records.text: He loved the song Homecoming in particular, which is Kanye (Kanye West)'s—it was his ode to Chicago, effectively—and it all just felt to me extremely providential, the timing of it all. And I should also mention that Ye (Kanye West) had not been back on stage in his hometown in over six years.
